guard: the runtime pid/log records are per-space, a pre-segmentation root-scoped record is still found and stopped across the upgrade, both spellings present fails loud, and one space's stop leaves the other space's daemon running

mutations.name: S1 the manager record goes back to a root-scoped name
mutations.expectRed: manager.pid resolves to a DIFFERENT record for a second space on the same root

mutations.name: S2 the delivery-aware marker goes back to a root-scoped name
mutations.expectRed: the delivery-aware marker is per-space too

mutations.name: S3 the compat READ stops admitting the pre-segmentation name
mutations.expectRed: with ONLY the pre-segmentation record present, the seam resolves to it

mutations.name: S4 the ambiguity refusal silently prefers the canonical record
mutations.expectRed: both records present is ambiguous and throws rather than picking one

mutations.name: S5 RESERVED_COTAL_CHILDREN keeps the root-scoped manager record
mutations.expectRed: "manager.pid" is no longer a literal child of .cotal/

mutations.name: S6 one root, one manager record: the CLI stop path hits the wrong space's daemon
mutations.expectRed: ...and beta's manager is UNTOUCHED — the defect this change fixes

mutations.name: S7 one root, one delivery record: stopping alpha's daemon stops beta's
mutations.expectRed: ...and beta's daemon survives with its record intact

mutations.name: S8 the supervise-side writer records root-scoped again
mutations.expectRed: both records exist after both managers recorded themselves

mutations.name: S9 the writer stops reclaiming a dead pre-upgrade record
mutations.expectRed: the dead pre-upgrade records are reclaimed
